title: ConfigUpdate
description: Payload published to the config.updates Kafka topic by the backend (M4). Flink operators (M2/M3) consume this to update threshold broadcast state and filter parameters.

cpm_warn_threshold.description: CPM value above which a reading is classified WARN (must be less than cpm_danger_threshold).

cpm_danger_threshold.description: CPM value above which a reading is classified DANGER.

area.description: Optional geographic bounding box filter. Flink operators discard events outside this box.

timespan.description: Optional event-time window filter (ISO 8601). Flink operators discard events outside this window.
